marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots diminishing to southeast 15 Monday
evening. Scattered flurries changing to snow overnight then to
scattered flurries Monday evening. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures near plus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 to 2 metres building to 2 to 3 near
midnight.<br/>
